title: University of Education Lahore Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: University of Education Lahore Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2004
ACT IV OF 2004
UNIVERSITY OF
EDUCATION, LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An act to amend
the University of Education,
Lahore Ordinance,
2002
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary,
25th
February, 2004]
No. PAP-Legis.2(19)/2003/577,
dated 23-2-2004. The University of Education, Lahore. (Amendment) Bill
2003, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 7th
January 2004, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 19th February,
2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement-----(1) This Act may be called the University of Education,
Lahore (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

No. PAP-Legis.2(19)/2003/577,
dated 23-2-2004. The University of Education, Lahore. (Amendment) Bill
2003, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 7th
January 2004, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 19th February,
2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
4. Addition of section 12-A in
Ordinance L of 2002.----In the said Ordinance, after section 12, the
following new section 12-A shall be added:--
" 12-A. Pro-Chancellor.---(1)
The Minister for Education, Government of the Punjab, shall be the
Pro-Chancellor of the University.
(2) He shall perform such duties
and functions and exercise such powers as may be assigned and delegated to him
by the Chancellor."
